analysis_notes.summary: Seattle's defensive strategy effectively eliminates the standard ground game but remains a major pass funnel for running backs out of the backfield.
analysis_notes.speaker: Brandon Anderson
analysis_notes.quote: They shut down the run game, they allowed the second fewest fantasy points to running backs, but the most running back receptions.

analysis_notes.summary: Daniels is expected back for Washington, but his health and rust levels are significant question marks on a highly congested injury report.

analysis_notes.quote: Washington has 23 names on their injury report.
